{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–17 (2002–2009 PDF slips), including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]]. It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 17]].}}
'''Premiere - Original VS17''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–17. [[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed|Virtual Set 17]] (The Force Unleashed) has official text as of 6 February 2009.<ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref><ref name="vs17">[[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed]]</ref><ref name="vc17">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020214437/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The pool includes [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]] (between original Virtual Sets 11 and 12). The short name '''POVS17''' and the reader name '''Original Virtual Open''' redirect here.

This is the complete [[Virtual Original]] constructed pool. The [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]] then opened the [[Virtual Legacy]] era; its first pool was [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.1]]. GEMP has no environment code for this pool.

== Organized play ==

Virtual Set 17 became legal on 6 February 2009.<ref name="vs2002" /> The [[2009 World Championship]] (October 2009) was played after the Block reorganization, in [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.1]].
